newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close at 21-month high.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close at 21-month high.

text.p: Taiwan's overnight interbank rate closed at a 21-month high on Monday on tight liquidity as the rejuvenated stock market sucked funds out of the banking system, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate closed at 8.323 percent against Saturday's 7.782 close -- far outside the central bank's target zone of 5.0-5.5 percent -- with 30-day commercial paper soaring to 7.50-7.75 against 7.25-7.50.
After a monthlong slump, the stock market sizzled anew on Monday to further a two-week-old bull run, ending 91.29 points or 1.03 percent higher at a seven-year closing high 8,925.12.
